investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC refinement probe: single unauthenticated GET of the official_programme_url, no browser/auth/retries; music-relevance assessed only from the retrieved content.

probe_history.reason: The single GET returned a "What’s On" page whose own category labels (SLT Show, SLT Audition, Visiting Show) and event titles are all plays, auditions, and a visiting stand-up comedy night (Good Ship Comedy) — e.g. Hedda Gabler, Beyond Therapy, Auditions: The Flint Street Nativity, Good Ship Comedy featuring Angela Barnes. No live band/concert/jazz/electronic/DJ/classical event appears anywhere. This conclusively answers the music-relevance question without escalation.

No live band/concert/jazz/electronic/DJ/classical programming of any kind is present anywhere in the retrieved page.
